reviews.comment: I despise public speaking so I was never going to like this class. For COMM 203, the professor doesn't matter nearly as much as the TA, and my TA was a relatively harsh grader. Mrs. Dubriwny's lectures aren't really relevant and pretty boring, but as attendance is required I was forced to attend them. She seems very kind though

She's not the best professor I've had, my only issue is with your papers she uses turnitin that has been flagging my original work as AI, and will fail you despite the fact that the site is not accurate. It was very frustrating especially knowing my work was original. Attendance is mandatory it is a grade, lectures are boring. She's OK.

Lectures are completely useless and she would start lecturing about the next speech when we hadn't even started writing the current speech. Her lectures were also political, long, and boring, but you have to go to them for attendance quizzes. The class itself wasn't too bad, it just depends on your TA and their grading style.

Mass lectures are useless, except for attendance being required for a grade (in-class quizzes). 
Assigns lectures over Thanksgiving break. 
The class moves too fast at the beginning of the semester with little guidance. 0 structure. 
Ironically terrible at public speaking.
Annoying attitude in class towards students.
Fairly politically biased

COMM 203- showed speeches by Trump, Obama, and a woman with AIDS. Made her opinions on politics pretty obvious. She lectured about the next speech before we had even given the one we were currently working on which was confusing. Attendance necessary.

I took Tasha for COMM 203. Attendance was mandatory, you have two free absences then get 5 points off your average for every absence after that. It was public speaking, but she held a packet and read straight off of it for each lecture, which was frustrating. She made the class very political even though it did not need to be. Her views were clear.

I had Dr. Dubriwny for both WGST 200 and WGST 420 and she was incredible for both. Definitely attend class, attendance/participation are a part of the grade in some way. She also makes class engaging and greatly encourages class discussions and participation. She is very easy to talk to and is very understanding. Fair grader and great feedback.

Professor Dubriwny is a great WGST professor and really cares about the students and the subject as a whole. She is very helpful outside of class and provides great feedback on assignments and papers. There is a lot of reading and attendance is greatly encouraged. Textbook is required and exams are open book/note
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof Dubriwny is amazing. She genuinely cares about her students and the material she is teaching. Super open to conversation and will never talk down to you. So sweet and open minded.

WGST 200 was so fun with Dr. Dubriwny. This class really had me thinking about different perspectives on such interesting topics, and I always looked forward to going to class! I loved talking to her after class, she always loves to listen. Discussion posts, 2 exams, and a group project made up most of the grade. Would definitely take her again!

i LOVE dr. dubriwny and am looking for an excuse to take other classes with her. she was seriously the best! the class content is soooo easy and she's extremely accommodating. there is one group project, but it's very doable. easily my favorite class this semester, and the one i got the most out of! you really get what you put in. highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you are reading this, it is a sign you should take Dr. Dubriwny. The discussions I had in this class were so fun and crazy interesting/educational. There is a 2 page paper due every week about the articles posted, but it is relatively informal. Class is mandatory - in the articles you get the exam information but in class we get to explore them

She is one of the nicest professors I've had at TAMU. The lectures are very interesting so it's easy to pay attention to her. If you ever have any questions she's always more than happy to help. Definitely recommend having her as a professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS PROF!! She is absolutely amazing and really wants students to succeed in her class. Assignments are easy and not too time consuming. She gives a study guide for the test that is very helpful. I highly recommend this prof, her lectures are great and you will actually enjoy being in this class.

Genuinely an amazing class! She's definitely one of my favorite professors I've had and I'm looking to take another one of her classes soon. Her lectures are really informative and interactive. She uploads all the reading assignments so you don't have to buy the textbook. Nothing too hard and you'll learn a lot!

Dr. Dubriwny is my favorite professor at Texas A&M so far! This class was so fun and interesting, and she genuinely wants you to learn. There are 3 open-note tests, 1 group project, 2 mini papers you can knock out in less than 30 minutes, and 3 "papers" you can do in less than an hour. Definitely recommend this class, I loved it!!

Dr. Dubriwny is amazing!! I've already signed up for her 401 class. Two exams, a group project, weekly participation discussions, and a few short essays. This class was very doable and as long as you read the book you'll be fine. The exams are open note/book. Her lectures were so interesting and she interacts with the class. Take her!!!

Hands down my favorite prof, and my fav class. TAKE HER! We did readings before class, and then discussed them in class. Then, had a final paper that we worked on for a while. All the readings were so interesting that it felt like it was leisurely reading. I wish I could take this class again. Just read, show up, discuss & write the paper!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved this prof! She just wants your opinion on different topics. As long as you participate and show effort she will give you great grades on your discussion posts. The exams are all online, so not too hard. The material is very interesting and I really enjoyed her lectures. Attendance counts too. I recommend this class!

Feminist theory was mainly a discussion based class but Dr. Dubriwny would always give us interesting readings and had great discussions the next day. She's the absolute best and would 10/10 recommend, also her classes are not just an easy A!
She is an amazing professor but you have to read and participate to do well in the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was once a week so she posts lots of 10 page articles to read and write a discussion post about before class. Attendance was mandatory, and there is 1 major group project. 2 exams that were based on all the articles.

Class once per wk, mandatory attendance. Really easy grader, just wants to know your opinion. 2 tests that arent too bad. Lots of readings that are pretty interesting. One relatively easy group project. Very passionate about her work. she handled discussions of heavy topics really well. You do have to do some work, but it isn't too bad.

Professor Dubriwny is the sweetest and funny professor I have ever had. She is always positive and is very passionate about what she is teaching. You can tell she loves her job and is always there if needed. Her class is interesting and easy.

I took her for WGST & I really enjoyed her & the class! She is a super easy grader, really just wants to hear your opinion and how you feel about certain topics. Easy discussion boards every week & a fair amount of reading. One final paper. I ended up with a 97 in the class. Also she's really funny & makes class interesting! Take her!
She cares so deeply about her students and is willing to read papers and assignments before they are do. She replies quickly. She has a lively personality, and makes class interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She's very into all of her lectures and you learn a lot. You HAVE to read the book or you'll be very lost when trying to do the weekly discussion posts. No tests, but there are 3 quizzes, a big paper, and a big group project. Would definitely take this class again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. Dubriwny is a very sweet lady and a pretty good prof. The highlight of this class was that were no tests however there was three quizzes, a major paper and a major group project. It wasn't a hard class, I would recommend her.

Took in Fall 2016. Awesome lectures, forced us to think and discuss and question. Discussion posts, a crossword puzzle (completion grade), around 4+ readings a week, videos, & audio lectures. Only allowed one unexcused absence--more are 20 points off FINAL grade. One final paper, one group project/presentation. 3 quizzes, no tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is friendly, and very upbeat, which makes this class better. The class is hard, but she gives a study guide, which is very helpful and straight forward with the tests. She will even sometimes in class tell you what she will put on the test. She can be confusing, and she talks super fast, but she's willing to help. You have to go to class.
